package domain

import (
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type CoursePlanStatus string

const (
	CoursePlanPlanning  CoursePlanStatus = "PLANNING"
	CoursePlanCompleted CoursePlanStatus = "COMPLETED"
	CoursePlanFailed    CoursePlanStatus = "FAILED"
)

const (
	CoursePlanResultCreated       = "COURSE_CREATED"
	CoursePlanResultReused        = "COURSE_REUSED"
	CoursePlanResultNoGap         = "NO_GAP"
	CoursePlanFailureInvalidGraph = "INVALID_GRAPH"
	CoursePlanFailureAttempts     = "ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED"
	CoursePlanFailurePathConflict = "LEARNING_PATH_COMMAND_CONFLICT"
	CoursePlanFailureCheckpoint   = "LEARNING_PATH_COMMAND_CHECKPOINT_INVALID"
)

type CoursePlanRequest struct {
	ID                    string                         `json:"id"`
	StudentID             string                         `json:"student_id"`
	IdempotencyKey        string                         `json:"idempotency_key"`
	RequestHash           string                         `json:"request_hash"`
	GoalCode              string                         `json:"goal_code"`
	LearningPathID        string                         `json:"learning_path_id,omitempty"`
	DiagnosticPlanID      string                         `json:"-"`
	Intent                PlanningIntent                 `json:"-"`
	Status                CoursePlanStatus               `json:"status"`
	ResultCode            string                         `json:"result_code,omitempty"`
	CourseID              string                         `json:"course_id,omitempty"`
	Reused                bool                           `json:"reused"`
	CourseFingerprint     string                         `json:"course_fingerprint,omitempty"`
	FingerprintVersion    string                         `json:"fingerprint_version,omitempty"`
	NormalizedContextJSON json.RawMessage                `json:"-"`
	GeneratedCourseJSON   json.RawMessage                `json:"-"`
	LearningPathCommand   *LearningPathCommandCheckpoint `json:"-"`
	FailureCode           string                         `json:"-"`
	Attempts              int                            `json:"attempts"`
	ClaimToken            string                         `json:"-"`
	LeaseUntil            *time.Time                     `json:"-"`
	NextAttemptAt         time.Time                      `json:"-"`
	CreatedAt             time.Time                      `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt             time.Time                      `json:"updated_at"`
	CompletedAt           *time.Time                     `json:"completed_at,omitempty"`
}

func NormalizeCoursePlanRequest(input CoursePlanRequest) (CoursePlanRequest, error) {
	input.ID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ID)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.IdempotencyKey = strings.TrimSpace(input.IdempotencyKey)
	input.RequestHash = strings.TrimSpace(input.RequestHash)
	input.GoalCode = normalizeCode(input.GoalCode)
	input.LearningPathID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningPathID)
	input.DiagnosticPlanID = strings.TrimSpace(input.DiagnosticPlanID)
	intent, intentErr := NormalizePlanningIntent(input.Intent)
	input.CourseID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CourseID)
	input.CourseFingerprint = strings.TrimSpace(input.CourseFingerprint)
	input.FingerprintVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.FingerprintVersion)
	requestDigest, digestError := hex.DecodeString(input.RequestHash)
	if !validCoursePlanUUID(input.ID) || !validCoursePlanUUID(input.StudentID) ||
		!validCoursePlanUUID(input.IdempotencyKey) || digestError != nil || len(requestDigest) != 32 ||
		input.GoalCode == "" || intentErr != nil || !validCoursePlanStatus(input.Status) || input.Attempts < 0 || input.CreatedAt.IsZero() ||
		input.UpdatedAt.Before(input.CreatedAt) {
		return CoursePlanRequest{}, ErrValidation
	}
	input.Intent = intent
	if input.CourseID != "" && !validCoursePlanUUID(input.CourseID) ||
		input.LearningPathID != "" && !validCoursePlanUUID(input.LearningPathID) ||
		input.DiagnosticPlanID != "" && !validCoursePlanUUID(input.DiagnosticPlanID) ||
		input.ClaimToken != "" && !validCoursePlanUUID(input.ClaimToken) {
		return CoursePlanRequest{}, ErrValidation
	}
	if input.Intent.Reason == PlanningReasonReplan && input.LearningPathID == "" {
		return CoursePlanRequest{}, ErrValidation
	}
	if input.DiagnosticPlanID != "" && (input.Intent.Source != PlanningSourceTeacher || input.Intent.Reason != PlanningReasonInitial) {
		return CoursePlanRequest{}, ErrValidation
	}
	if input.LearningPathCommand != nil {
		checkpoint, err := NormalizeLearningPathCommandCheckpoint(
			*input.LearningPathCommand, input.StudentID, input.ID, input.LearningPathID,
		)
		if err != nil {
			return CoursePlanRequest{}, ErrValidation
		}
		input.LearningPathCommand = &checkpoint
	}
	return input, nil
}

func validCoursePlanUUID(value string) bool {
	parsed, err := uuid.Parse(value)
	return err == nil && parsed.String() == value
}

func validCoursePlanStatus(status CoursePlanStatus) bool {
	return status == CoursePlanPlanning || status == CoursePlanCompleted || status == CoursePlanFailed
}
